messages.en: Lesson done~
What are you doing?
I changed my profile picture.
I miss you!!!!!!
Why did you add 🤓 ㅋㅋㅋ
This emoji is my favorite.
It looks so silly, so it's cute.
You look alike.
That's not it.
🫪 <- I like this one too because it looks silly.

messages.ko: 얜 미간 스페이스 너무 눌러놔서 좀 별루
messages.en: This one has its space between the eyebrows squished too much, so I don't really like it.
Did you have a good holiday?
I also spent mine eating, sleeping, and playing Roblox,
so the time went by really fast.
Didn't you double in size?
A little..?
So during my lesson,
I danced harder than usual
to sweat out some water weight ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Right now I really want Dujjim rose jjimdak and Mom's Touch Hot Spicy Boneless Chicken.
That's very specific…
I had Yukgaejang ramen for dinner.
I ate it.
I used to feel like I was eating poorly whenever I had ramen,
but lately I'm obsessed with ramen,
and it's so good.
Even when I go home, in the morning
I eat the meal Mom makes and ramen.
That's how I eat.
Convenience stores look like heaven to me…
Which ramen did you say you liked the most again??
Jin Jjambbong!!!

messages.ko: 진짬뽕 광고모델 되는게 나의 가장 큰 꿈이다.
messages.en: My biggest dream is to become the advertising model for Jin Jjambbong.
For that to happen,
I need a bag made with Jin Jjambbong,
clothes with Jin Jjambbong written on them,
change my phone case to Jin Jjambbong too,
change my wallpaper,
and carry it around all the time.
Wouldn't I stand out a little?
The reason I want to become an advertising model
is because I'm hoping they'd send me at least ten boxes of Jin Jjambbong.
That's my ulterior motive.
음흐흐흐흐
Hayeon, aren't you sleepy?
I have to go out again in a few hours,
and if I sleep for an awkward amount of time, I'll be even sleepier.
No, I'm not staying up all night.

messages.ko: 딱 어느정도 자야 개운하게 깨는 시간있잖아
messages.en: You know how there's a certain amount of time you need to sleep to wake up feeling refreshed?
I'm trying to figure out how many hours I need to sleep
so I won't be as tired.
But you're still awake at this hour??
What were you doing?

messages.ko: 너무너무 잠이 안와가지규 밀린 유튜브 봤어...😭😭😭😭😭😭😭
messages.en: I really couldn't sleep, so I watched all the YouTube videos I'd fallen behind on...😭😭😭😭😭😭😭
If you watch YouTube like that,
you'll have an even harder time sleeping!!
But you also watch science videos before sleeping.
Those are videos I watch to help me sleep..
Sleep?
ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'm tired, but I don't want to sleep.
Don't you like me?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 집에 벌레 나왔는데 어떡해요? 저 못 잡겠어요ㅠㅠㅠ
messages.en: A bug came into my house. What do I do? I can't catch itㅠㅠㅠ
I can't catch bugs either…
I can at least stay by your side.
We can be scared together.
What if there were 24 cockroaches?
What kind of example is this? ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
I'd have to kill them all.
I can't kill them with my own hands,
so I'll give each one a name
and make them do housework.

messages.ko: 너네는 소파밑에 쓰레기를 먹고 너네는 주방쓰레기 먹고 너네는 문앞에서 보초 서
messages.en: You guys eat the trash under the sofa, you guys eat the kitchen trash, and you guys stand guard by the door.
But that would be kind of gross.
But what's really interesting is,
bugs are really gross and scary,

messages.ko: 바다에 사는애들이 사실 더 징그럽게 생겼거든
messages.en: but creatures that live in the ocean actually look even grosser.
It's all about how you look at things.
But sea creatures are tasty at least.
Insects are tasty too.

messages.ko: 새우나 물고기 이런애들도 진짜 징그럽게 생겼는데
messages.en: Shrimp and fish and things like that look really gross too,
and clams are gross too.
Have you ever seen a clam swim???
With its tongue sticking out and crawling around.
But from an insect's point of view, we'd probably look gross too.
As long as it tastes good, I guess it's fine.
Since we don't usually have to prepare them ourselves..

messages.ko: 그래서 곤충이 맛있는지 어떻게 알아? 하연이 먹어봤어?
messages.en: So how do you know if insects are tasty? Have you tried them, Hayeon?
Actually,
I'm Bear Grylls' cameraman.
I've been keeping it a secret.
I have two jobs, so I'm always busy.
I just got back to Korea.

messages.ko: 알바 투잡도 힘든데 아이돌이랑 베어그릴스 카메라맨을 투잡뛰네
messages.en: Even working two part-time jobs is hard, but you're doing two jobs as an idol and Bear Grylls' cameraman.
I'm a magical girl.
I fly around.

messages.ko: 카메라맨 하면서 본 동물 뭐 있어?
messages.en: What animals have you seen while working as a cameraman?
A unicorn.
They really exist.
I saw one at a waterfall in the forest,
but it didn't look the way I imagined.

messages.ko: 긴 무지개빛 털에 이쁜 날개인줄 알았는데
messages.en: I thought it would have long rainbow-colored fur and pretty wings,
but it had short hair..
I guess it had a change of heart.
Apparently, it cut it recently.
It got the short-hair bug.
It needs to get through that phase wellㅜ
If it changes its mind later, I should get it hair extensionsㅠㅠㅠ
It's okay, I left it a few hair pieces.
I put one strand near its forehead like a highlight.

messages.ko: ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 유니콘 기분 더 나빠지는 거 아니지
messages.en: ㅋㅋㅋㅋ The unicorn isn't going to feel even worse, right?
No, it smiled brightly.
It had so many teeth.
Was its name Eureka?
옼ㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅋ
You remember.
That's the name of my imaginary friend.
Wasn't it Yunamssaeng?
You said you couldn't understand that one, so that won't work.
My joke skills have really declined,
but they get replenished when I spend more time with my family.
Since we all try to make each other laugh,
I come back with better joke skills after being with my family.
The reason I can't use them on broadcasts is
we always

messages.ko: 서로의 살짝의 조롱과 못생긴 표정이 디폴트라
messages.en: default to lightly making fun of each other and making ugly faces,
so it's a shame I can't use that on broadcasts.
I also want to, like DaHyun unnie,
try going live with my family.

messages.ko: 맞다 다현언니 아버님이 내가 최애라고 하셨대
messages.en: Oh right, DaHyun unnie's dad said I'm his favorite.
On the other hand, who's your dad's favorite?
My dad only watches my stuff.
He watches only my stuff all day,

messages.ko: 엄마랑 오빠가 노이로제 걸릴것같다고 그만보라고 한대 ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
messages.en: so Mom and my brother tell him to stop because they think they're going to go crazy ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Mom also watches my stuff all the time,
and my brother pretends he doesn't watch or know anything,
but he watches it all ㅋ
Did they happen to watch 'Destiny Magical Girl' too?
No, they played that in front of me,
so it was so embarrassing.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋ
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ That's quite an unfortunate incident.
Such an unfortunate incident.
I should probably go to sleep soon.
It's late,
so thank you for contacting me~
Sleep well~
Or
have a good day today!
Haranghae😘😘
